verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge lets agents update stored pages and not only read them. Edits reach running agents on their next turn, and Knowledge is said to keep itself current from connected sources. The docs never describe detecting contradictions or automatically superseding or merging conflicting memories; updates appear to be explicit page writes or added notes. Missing for 10: documented contradiction detection, supersede/merge semantics for conflicting facts, version history or conflict-resolution behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the memory layer to update, supersede, or merge memories when new information contradicts what was stored

citations.quote: With Knowledge, an agent can not only read information but update it too, allowing it to learn and self-improve over time.
For updates, the agent writes the page to the scope that matches the request.
Edit it, and running agents get the new version on their next turn.
